evals.prompt: How do we write a single Amazon Athena SQL query that performs a cross-catalog `JOIN` between CloudWatch S3 access/trail logs in `"s3tablescatalog/aws-cloudwatch"` and an S3 Inventory / metadata Iceberg table stored in a separate S3 table bucket catalog (`"s3tablescatalog/my-security-tables"`)?
evals.expected_output: Demonstrates querying across two distinct Glue/S3 Tables catalogs in a single Athena SQL statement (`"s3tablescatalog/aws-cloudwatch"."<namespace>"."<log_table>"` joined with `"s3tablescatalog/my-security-tables"."<namespace>"."<metadata_table>"`) and notes the required Lake Formation / Glue catalog permissions on both table buckets.
expectations: Writes a single Athena SQL query joining a table in `"s3tablescatalog/aws-cloudwatch"` with a table in `"s3tablescatalog/my-security-tables"` using full 3-part `"catalog"."database"."table"` references
Notes that the querying principal must have Lake Formation / Glue `SELECT` and `Describe` permissions on both S3 table bucket catalogs
